name: shadcn/svelte
summary: VS Code extension that installs shadcn-svelte components and adds Svelte 4/5 snippet completions in the editor.
description: Initializes the shadcn-svelte CLI and installs one or several components from a list without leaving VS Code, and opens the documentation or a component's docs page. Snippets (cn-help, cni-[component], cnx-[component] for Svelte 4; cn-x- variants for Svelte 5) are generated from bundled templates plus the latest component registry, with an import path setting for /index.js.
contains: install shadcn-svelte components from the editor
snippets: cn-help, cni-[component], cnx-[component], plus cn-x- for Svelte 5
reload component list without restarting VS Code
